newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline picks up $2 as swaps pull higher.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline picks up $2 as swaps pull higher.

text.p: NWE gasoline was pulled $2 or so higher on Tuesday as wet barrels tried to keep pace with a mini surge in swaps numbers.
Traders said paper sellers were very hard to find, particuarly for July, and that paper was around $4 a tonne stronger.

Premium unleaded barges into Germany were done at $186.50 and $186.25 while July swaps went at $185.50 and August at $186.00. Towards the close of the day paper levels put on about $1 in response to crude's latent strength with July figuring around $187.00.
